text:
matt: Hey folks — PR #17812 is blocked by CI, macOS shard 7 failing an image snapshot. Need a quick plan: update snapshot or do a targeted rerun? I’d like to get this merged before tomorrow morning. buildkite: https://buildkite.com/redwood/ci/builds/55213 (job 55213)

josh: Can you paste the failing assertion or diff?

matt: Here’s the tail of the failure from the job:
```
AssertionError: snapshot mismatch
expected: <image hashes differ>
actual:   <image hash 0x7b3a1f>
stack: /workspace/render/test/snapshot_mac_render.test.ts:142
```

tara: That hash drift looks like the font fallback change we saw last week on Big Sur. Usually a rerun sometimes fixes it (render timing), but if it consistently fails we should update the snapshot.

alex: +1 rerun first. If rerun passes, merge. If rerun fails again, bisect to see if it's this PR or infra. I can kick a targeted rerun if someone gives the go.

matt: @tara can you rerun shard 7? I don’t have permissions for targeted reruns. /cc @sasha for an extra reviewer if we need to update the snapshot.

tara: on it — running targeted job now. Command: `/bk restart --job=55213 --shard=7`

ci-bot: buildkite: Rerun started by tara for job 55213 (shard 7). New build: https://buildkite.com/redwood/ci/builds/55214 (job 55214). Status: queued.

josh: Thanks. If rerun passes, can someone approve while I do a quick sanity check? I’m +1 on merging if tests are green.

alex: I can review the diff in parallel. If rerun passes, do we prefer a small note in the PR saying we updated snapshots due to macOS render nondet?

sasha: I’m finishing a doc sync until 15:00 PST. If rerun passes I can do a quick look + approve around then. If it fails again, leave it for me and I’ll bisect after lunch.

ci-bot: buildkite: Job 55214 (shard 7) finished — PASSED ✅

matt: nice — rerun passed. Who’s going to merge? We still need one reviewer + approval (codeowner file says two for render/*).

josh: I’ll do the sanity pass now. Quick local repro attempt earlier couldn’t reproduce; rerun passing in CI is good signal.

alex: I skimmed the changed snapshot images — they look like subtle antialias differences, not functional. I’m +1 to update snapshots. Leave a note in the PR: "Updated macOS snapshots to match expected rendering on Big Sur/Monterey test images."

sasha: I reviewed and left an inline comment about the test flakiness triage steps. Approving now. :white_check_mark:

matt: Thanks @sasha — once you approve I’ll merge. I’ll also add a follow-up tech note in the PR about the flake and add a rerun checklist for tests that show render nondet.

josh: small nit — add the buildkite link to the PR description so ops can trace if it recurs.

matt: Will do. Merging in 2 mins after approval. Thanks everyone. :rocket:

ci-bot: buildkite: Merge initiated by matt for PR #17812. Merge commit: 9f4c2b6

alex: Nice! If this pattern repeats we should consider pinning fonts in test env or capturing more tolerant snapshot baselines. Filing a follow-up ticket.

matt: Filing now: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1314-track-macos-render-nondet-snapshots

tara: great — glad that was quick.

josh: thx all — saved us a merge window slot.
